description: Version Story compares versions of Word and PDF documents and produces redlines: PDF redlines and Word tracked-changes files. It can also merge separately edited revisions of one document, combine independent drafts, and build a version history that attributes each change to the version that introduced it. Requires a Version Story account; selected documents are uploaded to Version Story for processing and stored in that account.

defaultPrompt: Compare these documents and give me a redline.
Merge these versions into a consolidated redline.
Create a version history of my document showing which versions introduced which changes.
